'''Star Wars CCG''' is the [[Players Committee]]'s YouTube channel ([https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwzN9PSUyCvxzbvCRfScS6Q channel UCwzN9PSUyCvxzbvCRfScS6Q]). It holds recordings of the PC's live streams from its Twitch channel [[Swccgpc (Twitch channel)|swccgpc]], the weekly show [[Holotheatre]], tournament finals, player interviews, Hall of Fame inductions and Advocate Award shows. Its first uploads, two test videos and the stream "PPC Round 1", are dated 4 October 2014.<ref name="ppc1">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iDGSubRYGYA PPC Round 1], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (4 October 2014).</ref> On 15 October 2026 the channel's uploads list held 1,615 videos.<ref name="ch-pc">[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwzN9PSUyCvxzbvCRfScS6Q Star Wars CCG], YouTube channel of the Players Committee (uploads list, 15 October 2026).</ref>

== Content ==

Counted by words in the video titles on 15 October 2026, the uploads include about 270 videos from World Championships, about 225 from Match Play Championship (MPC) events, 204 Holotheatre episodes, about 130 GEMP-related videos, about 110 Retro events, about 80 from US Nationals, and smaller series for the Jawa Cup, Outrider Cup, Continentals and European events.<ref name="ch-pc" />

* '''Tournament streams.''' Feature matches and finals from Players Committee events: World Championships, US Nationals, Continentals, the MPC, the Outrider Cup and the Jawa Cup.
* '''[[Holotheatre]].''' The PC's live show, streamed on Twitch and uploaded here from March 2019.
* '''Interviews.''' Player interviews from the 2007 and 2013 World Championships and the 2019 MPC, and champion interviews from later events.
* '''Awards and tributes.''' Hall of Fame inductions and the yearly Advocate Awards shows (2021 – 2025), and a tribute to [[John Anderson]] recorded at the [[2019 North American Continental Championship]].<ref name="anderson">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lEORVHLKboo Star Wars ccg - 2019 North American Continentals- Tribute to John Anderson], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (29 August 2019).</ref>
* '''Design.''' The 2015 Design Q&A<ref name="dqa">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m-mTCWuHPqw Star Wars CCG Design Q&A], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (30 November 2015).</ref> and Holotheatre's ''Attack of the Designers'' (2023).<ref name="aotd">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lmnqre87HWo Star Wars CCG - Holotheatre S4 E22 - Attack of the Designers (full episode)], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (19 June 2023).</ref>

In 2026 the channel also uploaded older footage: player interviews and bonus content from the [[2007 World Championship]] (7 April 2026) and parts of the [[2013 World Championship]] finals (January 2026).<ref name="w07-booker">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PQSbe5jVd5k Worlds 2007 J. Booker Interview], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (7 April 2026).</ref><ref name="w13">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=csZcD0v9Cd0 Worlds 2013 Finals Game #1 P1], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (11 January 2026).</ref>
